text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, I find Super Creek in the<n>library.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fancy seeing you here. Are you on<n>the hunt for
a book too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for a reference book to<n>help with my
world history and<n>classic literature homework.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... there are so many<n>options, the
moment I think I've made<n>a choice, another goody
pops out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... if it's all right with you, I<n>could help you
search!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi there, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the sudden interjection. I<n>just happened
to overhear your<n>conversation, so...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, not at all! I'd really appreciate<n>your help. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
O-okay! As the student library<n>assistant, I'm
confident I'll find you<n>the perfect publication!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well, right off the bat, I think this<n>reference book
might be just what<n>you need!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It has plenty of annotations on<n>relevant terminology,
and it's full of<n>diagrams too, making it a pretty easy
read, I think! There's even some<n>funny trivia
included...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds absolutely perfect.<n>You've really
sold me on it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Oops, s-sorry for rambling on like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, don't worry! It's lovely that<n>you have
something to be passionate<n>about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We should believe in our passions<n>and keep
working at them, because<n>they're something to be
proud of. ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you very much... That's<n>encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to study more from your<n>recommendations,
Rob Roy. Can we<n>keep looking around? ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I do have some other ideas, so<n>let's see how
the other books<n>compare!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them continue their<n>search. But
before long...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? What happens next?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... "But they still couldn't pull out<n>the giant
carrot. That's when they<n>decided to work together
and..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, is that... a picture book?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm sorry! I saw this book and<n>thought it would
be great for the kids,<n>so... here I am...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It does look like a nice picture book. I<n>can imagine it,
too... children smiling at<n>story time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... but I'll have to save that for<n>another day! I
came here to find a<n>reference book.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right then, world history... world<n>history...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Oh, goodness me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy, I think I've found the perfect<n>picture book
for you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: For... me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The blurb says it's about a hero who<n>vanquishes a
terrible dragon. ♪ Oh, it<n>sounds fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's one we recently got in stock! Ihaven't been able to read it yet, but Ithink... no, I know I'll love the story!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Heehee. I figured as much. I'll read it<n>to you as
many times as you want. ♪
choice_data_list: You've got to find a reference book!
I wanna hear the story too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! What am I doing?<n>I'm sorry I keep
getting distracted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's... it's my fault too for getting so<n>excited... Okay,
we have to get<n>serious with our search!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right, classical literature... classical<n>literature...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ooh... This one's called TheDogfather and the Stray Wolf. It mightbe nice for story time too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't think that's the type of<n>"dogfather"
you're thinking about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm very sorry! I'm so silly<n>sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek continues her search for<n>a reference
book, all the while<n>struggling against her nurturing
tendencies.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm quite happy to read it to you<n>as well,
Trainer. Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A long, long time ago, a dreadfuldragon attacked a poor village andcaused ever so much trouble for thetownsfolk...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Creek's voice is so calming. I<n>suddenly feel so...
relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. Go ahead and take a little<n>nap, it's fine.
There, there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a refreshing story time, Super<n>Creek resumes
her book hunt with a<n>renewed sense of purpose.
